description: Caption shows 20 of 20 condl25 runs on four FlyWire variants at model noise sigma 0.05, extracting synaptic weight, latent embedding, resting potential, and time constant from the flyvis_conductance GNN. Training used embedding dimension 2, 1 epoch, batch 4, data augmentation loop 500, one-step training, fp32 precision, group lasso 25 on g_phi inputs, with regularisers W_L1 0.00015, W_L2 2.5e-06, g_phi_weight_L1 0.28, f_theta_weight_L1 0.05. Panels a-d plot learned versus true weight over the fitted edge fraction (60%, 61%, 59%, 62%); e-h show 2D embeddings colored by cell type; i-l and m-p show resting potential and time constant with outliers beyond ±0.2/±0.1 s bands.
facts:
CAPTION: Circuit parameter extraction from the general-form GNN (group lasso 25) on the four FlyWire connectome variants with low model noise (σ = 0.05; fold cv00 of experiment 7): e8 hybrid, e8 hybrid with proximal null edges (n.e.), FlyWire eye, and FlyWire eye with proximal null edges. (a–d) Learned against true synaptic weight ˆWij over the edges fitted by the template readout (60%, 61%, 59% and 62% of the edges). (e–h) Learned latent embeddings ai ∈R2 of all neurons, coloured by ground-truth cell type. (i–l) Resting potentials V rest i and (m–p) time constants τi of the template readout, outliers beyond the dotted ±0.2 / ±0.1 s bands in red; R2 (inlier, all-neuron in parentheses), slope and outlier fraction as in Tab. 2.
FACTS:
- experiment: 7: FlyWire hybrids: Known ODE and GNN
- arm: condl25
- runs: 20 of 20 landed
- cells: variant: e8_flywireRF_noise_005, e8_flywireRF_proximal_nulls_noise_005, full_eye_flywireRF_noise_005, full_eye_flywireRF_proximal_nulls_noise_005
- dataset: e8_flywireRF_noise_005_blank50_cv00
- model: flyvis_conductance
- embedding dim: 2
- model noise sigma: 0.05
- epochs: 1
- batch: 4
- data augmentation loop: 500
- training: one-step
- MLP precision: fp32
- regularisers: W_L1 0.00015, W_L2 2.5e-06, g_phi_input_group_L1 25.0, g_phi_weight_L1 0.28, f_theta_weight_L1 0.05
GLOSSARY (meaning of identifier fragments; use only these):
- blank50: in every video clip of the stimulus, the first 50% of the frames are replaced by blank frames
- cv00 .. cv04: cross-validation folds 0 to 4
- noise_free / noise_005 / noise_05: model noise sigma 0 / 0.05 / 0.5
- 010 / 020 after noise_005: measurement noise gamma 0.1 / 0.2
- flyvis_conductance: code name of the general-form GNN, g_phi = MLP(a_i, a_j, v_i, v_j)
- flyvis_known_ode: code name of the Known-ODE model (the generator's equation with learned W, tau, V_rest)
- condl25 / condl100: group lasso 25 / 100 on g_phi's input groups
- null_edges_pc_400 / null400: 400% extra null edges added to the connectome
- removed_pc_20 / rm20, removed_pc_50 / rm50: 20% / 50% of the edges removed
- hidden_020 / hid20, hid10: 20% / 10% of the neurons hidden
- s5h06 / s5h21: one frame in five observed, rollout horizon 6 / 21
- INR_davis: stimulus not given, learned by a SIREN network
- full_eye_flywireRF / e8_flywireRF: FlyWire eye / e8 hybrid connectome; proximal_nulls: with proximal null edges
